operators.name: relu_transform
semantics: Computes elementwise max(x, 0) exactly like torch.relu.
Preserves input shape [512, 512, 512], dtype float32, contiguous memory.

operators.name: smooth_l1_loss_mean_zero
semantics: Computes F.smooth_l1_loss(x, torch.zeros_like(x)) with default reduction='mean' and beta=1.0.
For each element z: if |z| < 1, loss = 0.5*z^2; else loss = |z| - 0.5.
Reduction is mean over all elements, returning scalar tensor shape [].
Elementwise ReLU on input tensor preserving shape [512, 512, 512], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Computes smooth L1 loss between ReLU output and zeros with mean reduction and beta=1.0; returns scalar tensor shape [].
Returns the scalar loss tensor unchanged.
